questions.question: 2. If specific gravity of a liquid is 0.78 and manometer head is 20 cm. Find the difference of pressure head. (Specific gravity of Hg = 13.6)

explanations.a:
The correct answer is 3.28 m. The pressure difference is calculated using the formula: Δh=h×(SGliquid/SGHg)
Δh=20×(0.78/13.6)≈1.147 m of Hg
Converting this to meters of water: 1.147×13.6≈3.28 m
